headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob Gonzalez leading the offense. In other news, the Chicago Cubs cruised past the Minnesota Twins 6-2, and the Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the New York Yankees 8-2. The Philadelphia Phillies took control of their game against the New York Mets, securing a 6-1 victory.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Will Vest, who was transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation. Other injured players include PJ Poulin, Richard Lovelady, Ryan Helsley, Stephen Kolek, Justin Sterner, Lourdes Gurriel Jr., and Jeff Criswell.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics for Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles traded Rudy Martin Jr. to the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the Washington Nationals traded Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Cleveland Guardians, securing a 7-1 victory. Jacob Gonzalez led the Pirates' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, handing the Pirates their loss. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th-inning homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall to Phillies in Dominant 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took control of the game with a strong performance, securing a 6-1 victory over the New York Mets. Jesús Luzardo led the way for the Phillies, earning the win with 5.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with standout performances from Colson Montgomery, Braden Montgomery, and Nathan Lukes contributing to the win. Trey Yesavage led the pitching effort for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Yankees in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 win over the New York Yankees, with Shohei Ohtani and Max Muncy leading the charge for the Dodgers.

top_news.title: **Vest Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Will Vest has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
